study type: Prospective cohort analysis combined with cross-sectional survey
outcome: Conversion rate to hysterectomy from planned conservative management
Acceptance and performance of conservative treatments by centers
cohort: The study included 234 women with confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) from 22 international centers, along with a survey completed by experts from these IS-PAS centers regarding their practices.
finding: Uterus-preserving treatment strategies such as focal resection appear to be safe alternatives to peripartum hysterectomy, although less than half of the IS-PAS centers perform them due to factors like lack of experience or concerns about reoperation and infection.
